name: model-economy
description: Generator/arbiter model economy for everyday agent work: reserves the premium session model for judgment and hands bulk reading/exploration and generation to subagents at haiku or opus, keeping the main context small. A PreToolUse hook redirects Explore spawns to its own read-only explorer agent (haiku at xhigh effort) and general-purpose spawns to its own worker agent (opus at medium effort); a SessionStart hook injects the economy principle each session.
